title: 🤖 REGAL Agent
text:
REGAL Agent is our AI helper for **Dragonheir: Silent Gods**: heroes, teams, gear, bosses and events.

**How to ask**
1. Type `/ask` in the message box
2. Click **question** and write your question
3. Press **Enter**

🔒 **In this room only you see your question and the answer.**
💬 You can use `/ask` in other rooms too, but there **everyone sees** it.

📊 **Members** get **10 questions per day**, **Officers and the Leader 20**. Recruits can't ask yet. Each answer shows how many you used, e.g. `5/10`.
🐉 REGAL Agent only answers Dragonheir questions.

_Tip: private answers disappear when you restart Discord, so copy anything you want to keep._
